doc.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023

title: Current big band charts and quoting in solos
summary: He adapts his hit records for big band; Honeysuckle Rose quote and quoting by Paul Desmond.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: When you get up from this session, will music — a musical task come back into your head?

I’m sure it will. I mean I’ve just done some charts, I’ve got a big band gig coming up — well two — in a couple of weeks. So I’ve just continued what I’ve been doing which is adapting hit records that I’ve had into big band settings. So I know nobody else is going anywhere near them.

I wanted to make a comment that I was watching a video of you and a big band and you were playing “I Wish I Knew.” And you were playing your curved soprano and I just wanted you to know that your quote in your solo of “Honeysuckle Rose” was noticed.
Well that’s good, yes. I mean sometimes — well I mean quotes are sort of — I’m not on Sonny Rollins’ sort of level of quotes, but —
But it’s an interesting process because you have to realize how do I fit this particular tune into this particular key? Right? It’s a mental gymnastics sort of thing.

Yeah, well the great one is — oh no, it’s one of the Christmas numbers that Chet Baker plays “June in January” in. I’m trying to remember which one. But it’s quite startling you know. Paul Desmond was the master of that.
